messages.subject: MCC tree - NAs introduced by coercion
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to plot an MCC tree, most of the trees I plot are working and i am using "read.beast" to load the MCC tree.  This is what i'm using to plot the MCC tree:

>p3 <- ggtree(mcc3, aes(color = Location), mrsd = "2015-12-03", size = 1.5) + scale_color_manual(values=c("mediumpurple4", "springgreen3")) +
  geom_point2(aes(label = round(posterior), subset = posterior >= 0.9), size = 4.5) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2010, 2016)) + theme_tree2()

Now i'm using the same commands for all the other MCC trees i'm plotting and the only difference is a couple of samples, but the phylogeography and everything was the exact same.  Running this command on the MCC tree gives me the following warnings:

>In function_list[[k]](value) : NAs introduced by coercion

When I then do:
 
>plot(p3) 

I get the following error:

Error: Continuous value supplied to discrete scale

And the tree does not plot.  How can I fix this problem?  Thanks!!!
